Class PolymerPreview

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.PolymerPreview
public final class PolymerPreview extends Object
One completed polymer-network model and the settings used to build it.

Use fragment() to inspect or edit its atoms and bonds, formula() for its finite formula, and reproduction() to save enough information to build the same model again.
